title: Owner: grant the reads, stage the skill, try it on the real tent, promote or retire
goal: The owner sees the answer for a real pot and decides
acceptance: Owner 2026-11-27 in chat: "ok" to starting the first real skills, a Grover check for "controlla se è richiesta un'altra dose"; read-only.

A copy-paste page (docs/acceptance/f153-grover-dose-<date>.md, by the agent) on NERV-01: (1) nerv tools grant grover/grover_overview, grover/grover_readings and grover/grover_feed_preview, each printing "granted as a read (Pattern Green), EVA-00"; (2) nerv skills stage <checkout>/skills/grover-dose.json prints status staged; (3) nerv chat "controlla se è richiesta un'altra dose al vaso <n>" and the English request, read against Grover's dashboard; (4) nerv skills promote grover-dose <version> --owner-approved only if satisfied, else nerv skills retire
The owner's decision and any wrong verdict (a B- record) are recorded in F-153
privacy: Invented tent, pot and readings only in Git and tests; the owner's real Grover data stays on the owner's machines.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-153 Verification
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A skill that could start a feed or any other effect is out of scope and goes to the owner as a separate decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one short procedure on the live service. Not a measurement.
